projects.title: Isoliq Inno 1
projects.description: A 3M-parameter GPT-style language model trained from scratch. An open-source exploration of the whole pipeline, from tokenizer to honest evaluation.
features: Corpus fingerprints, dataset audits and saved checkpoints
projects.challengesSolved: The pipeline ran successfully, but evaluation revealed unbalanced fine-tuning data. The important lesson: clean data is not automatically balanced data.
projects.architecture: Six transformer layers, six attention heads, a 192-wide embedding and a 512-token context. Built on Andrej Karpathy’s nanoGPT with PyTorch and a documented Google Colab workflow.
projects.outcome: Published a reproducible workspace for a 3,000,768-parameter model, including training configurations, tokenizer, audits and checkpoints.

projects.title: Daily Ledger

projects.architecture: Project links and implementation details will be added when available.

projects.title: Personal Chrome Extension
projects.description: A custom Chrome Extension that transforms the default new tab page into a personalized productivity dashboard with live clock, smart greetings, quick-access links, notes, and entertaining content.
features: Real-time live clock with hours, minutes, and seconds display.
Quick-access favorite links and bookmark shortcuts.
Notes section for quick reminders and daily note-taking.
Dynamic joke section for entertaining browsing experience.
Smooth animations and interactive visual effects.
projects.challengesSolved: Built a clean, performant new tab replacement using vanilla JavaScript and Chrome Extension APIs, ensuring instant load times and smooth animations without any framework overhead.
projects.architecture: Chrome Extension with Manifest configuration. HTML5 new tab page with modular JavaScript handling DOM manipulation, event handling, and Chrome Storage APIs for persistent user data.

projects.title: Signal AI
projects.description: An AI-powered desktop application that transforms real-time news and trending topics into high-quality social media content using Generative AI workflows.
projects.challengesSolved: Designed an AI processing pipeline that analyzes incoming news, extracts key insights, and generates contextually relevant social media content with refinement workflows for iterative improvement.
projects.architecture: Electron desktop app with React + TypeScript frontend (Vite bundled). Main process handles API routing (ai-router, news-feed, visual-brain modules). Renderer process manages UI components (CreateSection, NewsSection, OutputCanvas). Integrates Gemini AI and OpenAI APIs with RSS Parser for data sources.

projects.title: AI Plant Analysis Tool

features: AI-generated species and plant health insights
projects.challengesSolved: Connecting image uploads, multimodal analysis and PDF generation in a single workflow.
projects.architecture: HTML, CSS and JavaScript frontend; Express backend handles images with Multer, calls Gemini, and creates reports with PDFKit.

projects.title: AI-Powered Portfolio Assistant
projects.description: A portfolio assistant that answers questions using structured project, skill and experience context.

Typing indicators, sugggested questions, and recruiter chat memory.
